privacy-policy.html:
Welcome to TrendsWheel (accessible at https://trendswheel.com). Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you visit our website.

1. Information We Collect

We do not collect any personal information directly from users. However, we may collect non-personal data such as:

  • Browser type, device information, and IP address
  • Pages visited and time spent on our site
  • Cookies for analytics and ad personalization

2. Cookies & Google AdSense

We use cookies to enhance your experience and show relevant ads through Google AdSense. Google may use cookies (like the DoubleClick cookie) to serve ads based on your interests. You can manage or disable ad personalization by visiting Google Ad Settings.

Learn more about Google’s advertising policies here: Google Privacy & Terms.

3. Google Analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand website traffic and improve performance. The data collected is anonymous and doesn’t include personally identifiable information.

You can opt out of Google Analytics tracking using this tool: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

4. External Links

Our articles may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

5. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to secure data collected via cookies and analytics. However, please note that no data transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

6. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with the updated date.

7. Contact Us

For questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: info@trendswheel.com
